dialogue.content: ご相談を始めさせていただきたいと思います。まず、相談内容と性別、年齢、お名前の呼び方を教えて頂けませんか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to begin our session. First, could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss, as well as your gender, age, and how you would like to be addressed?

dialogue.content: はい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 最近怪我をして働くことができなくなってしまい、コロナの影響と相まって生活できるか心配です。性別は男27歳呼び方は「まる」で大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: I recently got injured and haven't been able to work. Combined with the impact of COVID, I'm worried about whether I can make ends meet. I'm a 27-year-old man, and you can call me 'Maru'.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。まるさんですね。お怪我をされてしまったのです？大変でしたね。お仕事中の怪我ですか？
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to meet you, Maru. So you were injured? That must have been difficult. Was it a work-related injury?

dialogue.content: いえ、プライベートでの怪我です。
dialogue.English: No, it was a personal injury.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。働くことに支障がでて、心配ですね。お仕事は今は休まれているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be worrying that it's affecting your ability to work. Are you on leave from your job right now?

dialogue.content: そうですね。今は完全自宅待機です。
dialogue.English: That's right. I'm required to stay at home full-time for now.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。けがの治療には時間がかかりそうなのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it seem like the treatment for your injury will take a long time?

dialogue.content: おそらく2ヶ月〜3ヶ月くらいだと思います。病院ではそのように言われました。
dialogue.English: Probably about two to three months. That's what the hospital told me.

dialogue.content: 結構な大怪我だったのですね。ただ、冒頭でもお話していた通り、コロナもあり、生活をご心配されているようですが、自宅待機の期間というのは収入はない状態なのですか？
dialogue.English: That must have been quite a serious injury. As you mentioned at the beginning, with the pandemic as well, you seem worried about your livelihood. During this period of being at home, do you have any income?

dialogue.content: そうですね。収入は無いです。コロナの影響でただでさえ減っていた収入も無くなってしまいました。
dialogue.English: That's right. I have no income. The income that had already been reduced due to the pandemic has now completely disappeared.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですか。けがも治療費がかかるでしょうし、収入が途絶えてしまったのは不安ですね。毎日お苦しい気持ちで過ごされていることを考えると、苦しくなります。
dialogue.English: I see. Your injury must have medical costs, and it's understandably concerning that your income has stopped. It pains me to think of you going through each day with such distress.

dialogue.content: そうですね。これからどうしようかとすごく悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm really struggling with what to do from here.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。現在収入がないのも、治療に差し障ると思うので、少しご提案をさせて頂いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Since having no income could also affect your treatment, may I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.content: はい。何かあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. What is it?

dialogue.content: 一つは、もし社会保険に加入していると、傷病手当金という手当が給付されます。詳しくは総務課で聞いてみてください。もし社会保険など加入していないとなると、社会福祉事務所で、生活資金の貸し付けをする制度があります。いずれかを申請して、生活資金の確保をしてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: One option is, if you are enrolled in social insurance, there is a benefit called a sickness and injury allowance. You can ask your company's General Affairs or HR department for details. If you aren't enrolled in social insurance, the social welfare office has a system for providing loans for living expenses. How about applying for one of these to secure funds for your living costs?

dialogue.content: そうなのですね！それは知りませんでした。この後見てみようと思います。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see! I didn't know about that. I'll look into it after this.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、ご確認してみてくださいね。怪我が完治したら、同じ職場に復帰する予定ですか？
dialogue.English: Please do check on that. Once your injury has fully healed, are you planning to return to the same workplace?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そうですね。その予定ではいます。
dialogue.English: Thank you! Yes, that's the plan.

dialogue.content: ただ、今回の傷病手当のことなど教えてもらえていなかったので、このままで大丈夫か少し不安になりましたね。
dialogue.English: However, since they didn't tell me about this sickness and injury allowance, I've become a little worried about whether it's okay to stay with them.

dialogue.content: 会社からですか？そうですよね。専門の課の担当者から、何かあっても良かったですよね。
dialogue.English: From your company? I agree. It would have been nice if someone from the relevant department had mentioned something, right?

dialogue.content: そうです。知らないってことは無かったと思うので、例え自分が知っていたとしても、確認で教えてくれてもいいものですよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. I doubt they were unaware of it, so even if I had known, it would have been nice for them to mention it just to confirm.

dialogue.content: そうですよ。こんなに長くお休みを取るのに、一言あっていいかと思います。お仕事は勤められて長いのですか？
dialogue.English: Exactly. When you're taking such a long leave of absence, a word from them would be appropriate. Have you been working there for a long time?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。仕事自体はまだ1年ほどです。転職しています。
dialogue.English: Right. I've only been at this job for about a year. I switched from another one.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか！お仕事は楽しいですか？
dialogue.English: Oh, I see! Do you enjoy your work?

dialogue.content: 仕事は楽しいです。なので、怪我が治ったらそのまま復帰しようとは思っています。
dialogue.English: I do enjoy my work, so I'm planning to go right back once my injury heals.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか！お仕事楽しいのは何よりですね！怪我が早く治るといいですね！最初にコロナもあって不安。。との事でしたが、けがの状態次第では、会社を辞めることなども考えていたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see! It's wonderful that you enjoy your work. I hope your injury heals quickly. You mentioned at the beginning that you were also anxious because of COVID; were you considering things like leaving the company, depending on the state of your injury?

dialogue.content: はい！早く治していこうと思います！そうですね。怪我をしたのが足のため、仕事は立ち仕事なのでどうにもならなくなりそうなら仕事を変えようかと考えてもいました。
dialogue.English: Yes! I'm focused on healing quickly. And you're right. Since I injured my leg and my job is a standing one, I was considering changing jobs if it seemed like I wouldn't be able to manage.

dialogue.content: あと、怪我で家にいる時に悩みすぎて寝れなくもなったので…
dialogue.English: Also, while I was at home with the injury, I worried so much that I couldn't sleep...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。眠れないほど悩んでいたのですか。。お辛かったですね。お金のことは、きっても切り離せないですもんね。
dialogue.English: I see. You were worried to the point you couldn't sleep... That must have been very hard for you. Financial matters are inseparable from our lives, aren't they?

dialogue.content: そうですね。生活が出来なくなるのが一番怖かったので。
dialogue.English: Yes. I was most afraid of not being able to make a living.

dialogue.content: とりあえず、最低限生活できるようにはしたいと思っていました。
dialogue.English: For now, I just wanted to be able to secure at least a basic living.

dialogue.content: また、今の仕事が好きな仕事とおっしゃられていたので、辞めるのもつらいでしょうし、新しい仕事に就いて、人間関係や仕事の方法を一から学んだり、はたまたコロナのせいで理想通りの仕事に就けるかなど、不安は尽きませんよね。
dialogue.English: And since you mentioned you like your current job, it would be painful to quit. Plus, with a new job, you have to learn everything from scratch, like building new relationships and work methods, not to mention the uncertainty of finding your ideal job because of the pandemic. The worries are endless, aren't they?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。やっと慣れてきたところでこのようなことになってしまったので、仕事は辞めたくないですね。
dialogue.English: Exactly. This happened just as I was finally getting used to it, so I really don't want to quit.

dialogue.content: 一応、他の仕事も探してみましたが、コロナの影響で全然見つかりませんでした。
dialogue.English: I did look for other jobs, just in case, but I couldn't find anything at all because of the pandemic.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お仕事変わるのはストレスですよね。お仕事探されたのですか！まるさん本当に毎日追い詰められていたのですね。怪我と経済的不安で押しつぶされそうでしたよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. Changing jobs is stressful, isn't it? You actually looked for other jobs! Maru, you must have been feeling truly cornered every day. You must have felt like you were about to be crushed by your injury and the financial anxiety.

dialogue.content: よく一人で耐えてましたね。周りの方に不安な気持ちを相談されたりはしなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: You've endured so much on your own. Did you not talk to anyone around you about your anxieties?

dialogue.content: そうですね。今の仕事に転職した際も結構大変でした。デスクワークを探してみました。はい。かなりキツかったです。
dialogue.English: That's right. It was quite tough when I switched to my current job, too. I looked for desk work. Yes, it was really hard.

dialogue.content: いえ、近くに身内や友達がいないので相談はしていなかったです。
dialogue.English: No, I don't have any family or friends nearby, so I didn't talk to anyone.

dialogue.content: 現在のお仕事も探すのが大変だったところに、今回のことがあり。。大変でしたね。デスクワークなら体を動かさずに済みますものね！現実的に転職を考えてた様子がみえます。。身近にご相談できる方もいないとなれば、一人で抱えて相当苦しかったですね。ご相談いただいて、ありがたいです。
dialogue.English: On top of the difficulty you had finding your current job, this happened... It must have been so hard. With desk work, you wouldn't have to move your body, right? I can see you were realistically considering a job change. With no one nearby to talk to, you must have been in so much pain carrying this all by yourself. I'm grateful that you chose to speak with me.

dialogue.content: まるさんは、他にご心配なことはありませんか？
dialogue.English: Maru, is there anything else you're worried about?

dialogue.content: そうですね。大変でした。こればっかりは自分でやってしまったことでもあるので、やむを得ないです。そうですね。たまたまここを見つけられてよかったです！
dialogue.English: Yes, it's been tough. But this is something I brought on myself, so it can't be helped. I'm glad I happened to find this place!

dialogue.content: いえ、とりあえず教えていただいた所を調べてみようと思います。
dialogue.English: No, for now, I think I'll look into the options you told me about.

dialogue.content: 怪我をされたことでご自身を責めていたのですね。命があるだけ、本当に良かったと思います！また、一人で不安を乗り越え、ここでお話しして頂けて、よかったです。ご提案した情報がお役にたち、まるさんの怪我が治ってくれたら幸いです。他にご相談がないようでしたら、相談を終了させて頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: You were blaming yourself for getting injured. I truly think it's wonderful that you're alive and well. Also, I'm glad you endured your anxiety on your own and were able to talk about it here. I hope the information I suggested is helpful and that your injury heals. If you have nothing else you'd like to discuss, may we conclude our session?

dialogue.content: 本当にありがとうございます！はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Thank you so much! Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: かしこまりました。まるさんのお怪我が完治して、心身ともに元気いっぱいまた働けることを祈っております。今日はご相談頂きまして、有難うございました！
dialogue.English: Understood. I'll be hoping that your injury heals completely, Maru, and that you'll be able to work again full of energy, both in mind and body. Thank you for speaking with me today!

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you as well!

dialogue.content: maru様ロールプレイ、お疲れ様です、ありがとうございました！これにて、終了させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Maru, thank you for the role-play. That was great. Is it alright if we conclude here?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！はい！大丈夫です！お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.English: Thank you! Yes, that's fine! Great work today!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！ロールプレイ、終了します。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. This concludes the role-play.
